result.rationale: The handler computes `uniqueGuests` (filtering out existing attendees) for the DB write, but passes raw `guests` to `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)`. In email-manager, `if (newGuests.includes(attendee.email))` sends `AttendeeScheduledEmail` (full 'you're booked' email) instead of `AttendeeAddGuestsEmail`, so an existing attendee listed in the input receives the wrong email despite not being re-added. The mechanism is fully verifiable in the diff.
